headline: Biotech Stock Queen's 'Contribution to Index Gains Too Strong' Sparks Debate; TWSE Steps Out to Clarify and Restore Data
summary: Biotech company Pei-Er Biomedical-KY will change its par value from NT$10 to NT$0.5 in a 1-to-20 split. September 26 is the last trading day before the split, with new shares expected to resume trading on September 7.
why: A stock split changes the number of shares outstanding and their price without altering a company's total market value. Investors track split dates to manage their positions.
